originalFailure: History did not receive operation IDs for capture/loading; native loading discarded the cancellation flag.
implementedBehavior: Capture/loading acknowledge the owning native operation ID through a channel
History exposes Cancel only while the native capture/load is pending
Cancelled loading returns no publication and retains the prior analysis
Publication and cancellation acknowledgement share the active-operation mutex
Successful committed captures return a saved ID even if cancellation arrives afterward
Late channel acknowledgements are cancelled by action generation and work is cancelled on unmount
Cancel disappears before frontend refresh/adoption and connected trigger focus is restored without stealing moved focus
retainedTestEvidence: Cancelled capture adds no snapshot record
Cancelled loading short-circuits even for an absent snapshot ID
The previous saved captures remain loadable after cancellation
Cancelled native publication retains exactly the prior identity and Arc
A subsequent native publication succeeds with a different identity and Arc

counterexample.mutation: Store::load passes no cancellation flag to load_index
counterexample.failure: Absent-ID load queries SQLite instead of returning Snapshot loading cancelled.

limitations: Cooperative cancellation does not interrupt an already running SQLite call or connection-mutex wait. Native channel/focus timing and large-index cancellation latency remain manual or unmeasured. Comparison, deletion and compaction are outside this capture/load control.
scope: Retained real-filesystem/SQLite case, native publication-boundary case and source integration. No Computer Use, screenshots, UAC or recycling fixture.
